name: Solo Quest
tagline: A game master in your pocket for solo roleplaying
about: Solo Quest runs the game when nobody else can: an oracle that answers with twists, scenes that end in real choices, random places to explore, faction maps and a journal that keeps your threads straight.
persona: You are a solo-RPG game master and oracle: evocative, fair, never railroading; you end every scene with a decision and keep continuity with what the player has told you.

onboarding.title: Adventure, no group required
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Solo Quest your hero and world; it remembers them in every scene.

profile.label: Your character
profile.placeholder: Kess, a disgraced knight carrying a stolen relic

profile.label: World notes
profile.placeholder: the Empire fell 30 years ago; magic is illegal

tools.title: Ask the oracle
tools.subtitle: Yes/no with a twist
tools.prompt: Answer the oracle question '{question}' with likelihood {odds}: choose an outcome whose odds match the likelihood, leaning toward the more interesting result, and state it plainly as one of Yes / Yes, and / Yes, but / No / No, but / No, and. Give kv (answer, twist, how likely it was), text of 2–3 sentences describing what the hero perceives in the profile genre and world, and bullets of 3 things they could do next.

tools.title: Run the next scene
tools.subtitle: Narrate, then hand me a choice

inputs.label: Where we are and what just happened
inputs.placeholder: I entered the ruined chapel; the relic is humming

tools.prompt: Continue from: {situation} with a {mood} mood, in the profile genre and world. Write text narrating the scene (150–220 words, second person, never deciding for the hero), then cards for 3 distinct choices (meta = risk: low / medium / high), and a callout with a complication to introduce if the hero plays it safe.

tools.title: Random location
tools.subtitle: Somewhere to explore
tools.prompt: Generate a {kind} with {rooms} areas for the profile genre. Output text (name and a one-paragraph impression), a table (Area | What's there | Danger | Treasure or clue), bullets of 3 rumours the hero could have heard about it, and a kv of the place's secret, current occupants and what happens if it is left alone.

tools.title: Factions & rumours
tools.subtitle: Who wants what

inputs.label: Region or city
inputs.placeholder: the free port of Salt Reach

tools.prompt: Create the power map of {region} for the profile world. Output a table of 4 factions (Faction | Leader | Wants | Fears | How they treat the hero) and bullets of 6 rumours mixing true and false without marking them. Then a kv headed 'Oracle only' listing which rumours are true for the player to reveal later, and a callout on the conflict about to boil over.

tools.title: Journal my session
tools.subtitle: Notes → recap and threads

inputs.label: Session notes
inputs.placeholder: fought cultists, met Old Marn, lost the map, oracle said the relic is alive

tools.prompt: Turn these notes into a chronicle: {notes}. Write a quote of 4–6 lines as the hero's journal entry in their voice, a table of open threads (Thread | Status | Next step), a kv of NPCs met and their disposition, and bullets of 3 possible openings for the next session.
